Films · February 2024

Charming

A brand commercial for Virtual Enterprise

A brand commercial for Charming, produced for Virtual Enterprise and created for the national commercial competition, where it placed in the global top 25%. The spot follows the charm bracelets from shelf to wrist — leaning on warm, film-inflected color and quick cuts to sell the feeling of finding the piece that's you.
